requirements.title: REWIND positions the file at its initial point
requirements.definition: Execution of REWIND causes the specified file to be positioned at its initial point.

requirements.title: REWIND on a connected nonexistent file is permitted
requirements.definition: Execution of REWIND for a file that is connected but does not exist is permitted.

pending.rewind-connected-nonexistent-permitted: Guarded plan: only if a named connected file can be observed by INQUIRE(FILE=, EXIST=) to not exist, execute REWIND with IOSTAT initialized to a nonzero sentinel and assert no error status.

requirements.title: REWIND on a connected nonexistent file has no effect on any file
requirements.definition: Execution of REWIND for a file that is connected but does not exist has no effect on any file.
